blockingIssues.description: The consolidation left duplicate local asString helpers in packages/backend/convex/stripe-utils.ts, packages/electron-agent/src/main.ts, and packages/electron-agent/src/logic/type-guards.ts, so VAL-CON-002's single shared implementation requirement is not satisfied.

The consolidation left local/ad hoc truncation logic in packages/extension/tools/browser-read-tools.ts and packages/extension/sidepanel/ui/chat/chat-messaging.ts, and the browser-read-tools helper changed behavior during refactor, so VAL-CON-004 remains unresolved.

appliedUpdates.description: Added .factory/library/consolidation-scrutiny-notes.md documenting the Biome text-reporter false alarm pattern and the concrete consolidation follow-up areas identified by scrutiny.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update refactor-worker final validation guidance to explain how to handle pre-existing npm run check:repo-standards failures and explicitly allow/report a diff-scoped fallback such as --base=<ref> for isolated refactors.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: This surfaced across multiple reviewed features: consolidate-asrecord, consolidate-asstring, consolidate-sleep, fix-duplicate-constants, and fix-circular-dependency all reported check:repo-standards friction or inaccurate followedProcedure handling tied to unrelated pre-existing violations.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that workers must mark skillFeedback.followedProcedure false whenever any required validator fails, even if the failure is unrelated to their diff, and describe how to document that deviation consistently.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review reports for consolidate-asrecord and consolidate-asstring both found handoffs marking followedProcedure=true despite check:repo-standards exiting 1.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a consolidation guideline explaining when wrapper helpers that return metadata objects should delegate to shared primitives versus remain local, to avoid incomplete shared-utility migrations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The consolidate-truncate review found browser-read-tools.ts kept a local truncate wrapper while the feature still claimed full consolidation, indicating ambiguity in current mission guidance.

rejectedObservations.observation: Update deep-import-analysis-report.json to reflect the new MAX_FAILURE_TRACKER_ENTRIES location.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected for this scrutiny pass because the file is a generated analysis artifact, not operational guidance, and refreshing it would require a separate regeneration workflow outside low-risk factual library/services updates.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a second AGENTS.md note repeating that check:repo-standards defaults to a 300-line limit.
rejectedObservations.reason: Rejected because .factory/library/extension-core-notes.md already documents the 300-line default; the real gap is fallback procedure guidance, which is captured in suggestedGuidanceUpdates.
